purpose: Ratify the active blind prospective E-event automation as statically and synthetically operationally sound while keeping the first actual GitHub daily scheduler execution as a separate empirical confirmation item.

transport_reliability.removed_failure_class: CNInfo homepage transport failure aborting the whole cycle before independently reachable official target PDFs are attempted

binding: patched V2.8.4 prospective runner blob df07a5d2a5771deff39528c3533a39934e96a68c

validated_operational_properties: The active workflow is scheduled once every calendar day at 01:00 UTC / 09:00 Asia/Shanghai.
The three-calendar-day AS_OF-2 through AS_OF overlap is preserved.
The workflow uses a single non-cancelling concurrency group to serialize manual and scheduled executions.
The pipeline order remains scan -> authoritative observation commit -> finalization -> finalization commit -> shadow append -> blind readiness audit.
The authoritative observation commit exists before finalization computes prospective observed time and effective-date consequences.
A candidate not present in the authoritative observation ledger remains eligible for rediscovery on the next overlapping daily scan.
A successfully observed announcement is deduplicated by announcement_id on subsequent overlapping scans.
An exact duplicate V2.8.12 shadow event is a no-op; a same-announcement binding conflict fails closed.
An individual target-PDF/materialization/classifier failure is isolated as a BLOCKED filing and does not create eligibility effect.
The unnecessary CNInfo homepage preflight has been removed while direct official target-PDF retrieval and validation remain intact.
No outcome resolver, D5/D10 forward return, price/return research, broker/order execution, fold3/fold4, Setup, First60, Episode or live path was introduced.

failure_and_recovery_semantics.candidate_collection_failure_before_rece: No authoritative observation commit is produced; the next daily run's three-calendar-day overlap is expected to rediscover still-in-window announcements.
failure_and_recovery_semantics.individual_target_pdf_failure: The filing is recorded BLOCKED in the observation result for that run and is not appended to the successful observation ledger; while still inside later overlap windows it remains eligible for rediscovery/retry.
failure_and_recovery_semantics.successful_observation_reseen: announcement_id deduplication prevents a duplicate authoritative observation.
failure_and_recovery_semantics.git_write_serialization: Shared concurrency plus pull --rebase before push reduces concurrent write races; conflicts fail the workflow rather than silently overwrite ledger history.

scheduler_empirical_confirmation.reason: The every-calendar-day cadence was activated after the current day's 09:00 Asia/Shanghai trigger time, so no actual schedule-triggered run under the new cadence had occurred when this audit was frozen.
scheduler_empirical_confirmation.what_will_count_as_confirmation: A future workflow run whose event is schedule, whose workflow path is .github/workflows/v284-controlled-prospective-e-layer.yml, and which passes the bound validation/collection/finalization/shadow sequence.
